edge_cases: 2x2 grid of 32x32 output tiles; each accumulates over 2 K-tiles
HMX accumulator persists across K-tile matmuls (one mxclracc per out tile)
activation int8 in high byte of crouton slot (low bytes dead)
weight 4-deep packed; different load limit than activation
HMX 0x40-config requant gives the native matrix-engine output r=(acc*17+8)>>4, sign-extended from the 12-bit field
per-output-column int32 bias, saturate to int8, then a 256-entry GELU LUT (index=val+128) fused into the HVX epilogue
gelu_lut is a runtime parameter -- candidate must not hardcode it
bias includes extreme (-3000/+3000) and zero edge values to force both LUT-saturation ends and a zero-bias column
crouton pack/unpack staged via cacheable buffers + bulk vector copy
